A short-term housing strategy should prioritize furnished rentals to minimize upfront costs and avoid resale hassles, while buying used furniture with high resale value (bed, desk, chair) and targeting a net cost under $600 after five months. Month-by-month, focus: M1 on temporary setup, M2-4 on establishing routines, M5 on selling items and preparing to depart.

Before locking in longer-term commitments, evaluate the service's contract terms, cancellation fees, portability, and whether the benefit justifies cost for five months. Prioritize month-to-month plans and flexible services over annual contracts to maintain mobility when your stay ends.
